notes: Modified cash basis, aligned with FY2023/FY2024 choices. Governmental statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); Bond and loan proceeds 90,760 printed under Other Financing Sources -> debt_proceeds. Fund balances 1,769,318 + 1,707,905 - 1,565,288 + 90,760 + 4,000 - 4,000 = 2,002,695 (p6). Cash from the governmental funds statement (2022 Total Governmental Funds and 2021 Totals columns, p4) as the sum of the cash lines (claim on cash, county treasurer, restricted cash); investments separate. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary funds statement Total column (p8); receipts total computed (operating revenues + interest income); disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 276,581 (p2). Business-type transfers are between Water (out 17,850) and Sewer (in 17,850) and net to zero, so transfers_net is null. 1,797,041 + 390,406 - 276,581 = 1,910,866 (p9). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) because the governmental funds statement includes interfund due to/from (totals differ); component unit column excluded. Street Fund intergovernmental recorded as other state aid (highway allocation not printed). Detail: per fund column of the governmental funds statement (General, Street, Debt Service, Sales Tax), the nonmajor combining statement (Clinic, Cemetery Perpetual Care, Community Development; p10) and the proprietary statement (Lottery, Water, Sewer); the all-funds budget schedule (p11) is a combined schedule and is not recorded.
